intro: Slovakia is a parliamentary republic and a member of the EU, NATO and the eurozone.

chapters.title: President and parliament
text: The president is elected directly for five years. The National Council, a single chamber of 150 members, chooses the government led by the prime minister. Slovakia has eight regions.
The flag is white, blue and red with a coat of arms showing a double cross on three hills.

chapters.title: Slovakia in the world
text: Slovakia joined NATO and the EU in 2004 and the eurozone in 2009. Its politics are often divided over relations with Russia, Ukraine and the EU.

keyTerms.meaning: The group of EU countries that use the euro.
